questions.q: Where do you put the LinkBox widget so that EdgeTX 2.12 on a TX16S finds it at startup?
options: /SCRIPTS/WIDGETS/LinkBox.lua
/WIDGETS/LinkBox/main.lua
/SCRIPTS/TELEMETRY/linkbx.lua
/WIDGETS/LinkBox.lua
questions.explain: The radio goes through the folders in /WIDGETS and looks for a main.lua file in each (widgets.cpp, LUA_WIDGET_FILENAME "/main.lua"). A separate .lua directly in /WIDGETS is not loaded.

questions.q: Why does the TX16S menu have no telemetry screens with a script from /SCRIPTS/TELEMETRY?
options: The LUA_MIXER mode enabled on the radio forbids them
Such scripts work only over the FrSky S.Port protocol
Telemetry scripts are built only for monochrome radios
On a color radio a telemetry script name must be longer than 8 characters
questions.explain: Loading telemetry scripts in interface.cpp sits under PCBTARANIS, that is, monochrome radios only. On color radios widgets do the same job.

questions.q: The file /WIDGETS/LinkBox/main.lua is in place, luac -p finds no errors, but LinkBox is not in the widget list, and there is no error on screen either. What is most likely?
options: The returned table has no background function
The returned table has no options key
The refresh function does not call lcd.refresh()
The update function is not declared local
questions.explain: A widget is registered only if it has name and create (widgets.cpp:146) and an options table: without it parseOptionDefinitions returns NULL and no factory is created. An empty options = {} is enough.

questions.q: When does EdgeTX 2.12 call a widget's background function?
options: Every 50 ms together with refresh, regardless of the screen
Only when the widget's zone is not visible on screen
Only when telemetry from the receiver is lost
Once when the model loads, before create
questions.explain: WidgetsContainer::refreshWidgets calls foreground() (and through the redraw, refresh) for a visible zone and background() for a hidden one. That is why shared sensor-polling code is called from both functions.

questions.q: In refresh(widget, event, touchState) the event argument is always nil. Why?
options: The widget is shown in a zone, not in full-screen mode
A radio without a touchscreen passes no events to Lua at all
The options table does not declare a SWITCH type
Only the background function receives events
questions.explain: lua_widget.cpp passes the event code and the touch table only in fullscreen; in an ordinary zone both arguments are nil, and the radio's interface handles the presses itself.

questions.q: The link was lost 3 s ago. What does getSourceValue(id) return for the RxBt sensor that was being received before?
options: 0 and isCurrent = false
nil: the sensor is removed from the list
The last value and isCurrent = false
The last value and isCurrent = true for another 20 s
questions.explain: When the telemetry stream stops, EdgeTX marks all sensors as old (telemetry.cpp:413), and getSourceValue returns the last value with isCurrent = false. getValue in the same situation returns 0.

questions.q: A widget calls lcd.drawNumber(x, y, getValue("RxBt")) and at 16.4 V shows "ERROR in refresh()". How do you fix it?
options: Add the DBLSIZE flag: the large font shows fractions
Pass math.floor(v * 10 + 0.5) with the PREC1 flag
Switch to lvgl, where drawNumber accepts fractions
Rename the RxBt sensor to Batt in the telemetry list
questions.explain: RxBt has 0.1 precision, Lua gets 16.4 (a float), and drawNumber needs an integer (luaL_checkinteger): Lua 5.3 fails with "number has no integer representation". An integer in tenths plus PREC1 gives "16.4".

questions.q: LinkBox with Cells = 0 is connected to a 6S discharged to 3.50 V per cell (21.0 V). What does the auto estimate ⌈V / 4.40⌉ show, and what do you do?
options: 6S and 3.50 V/cell: the auto estimate is right at any charge
4S and 5.25 V/cell: change the sensor
5S and 4.20 V/cell: set Cells = 6 in the options
7S and 3.00 V/cell: lower the 4.40 V divisor
questions.explain: 21.0 / 4.40 = 4.77, and rounding up gives 5: a full 5S and an empty 6S give the same voltage. The estimate is right while the voltage per cell is above 4.40·(n−1)/n (3.67 V for 6S); for flying, set the cell count explicitly.

questions.q: What happens if a widget's refresh executes more than about 20 000 Lua instructions in one call?
options: The radio skips a frame and continues with the next one
The rest of the work is automatically moved to the next background call
The whole Lua environment reloads together with the model
A "CPU limit" error; the widget instance is disabled until it is recreated
questions.explain: The hook counts instructions in blocks of 200 (MAX_INSTRUCTIONS = 20000/100) and after 100 % calls luaL_error("CPU limit") (widgets.cpp). The error is written into the zone, and this instance is not called again until the widget is created anew (a model change, a screen edit, a reboot). In DEBUG builds the limit is only printed.
